title: Logged model search order_by must end with a unique model_id tiebreaker
answers: logged model search results change between pages when sort values tie
why does search_logged_models need a stable sort order for pagination
model_id tiebreaker logged models order by
body:
Invariant: _apply_order_by_search_logged_models makes the ORDER BY total so each page token resolves to a unique position. It appends creation_timestamp_ms desc when the caller did not sort by creation time, then appends model_id asc as the final key unless the caller already ordered by model_id (has_model_id guard).
Enforced in: mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:_apply_order_by_search_logged_models.
What breaks if skipped: When user-provided sort keys tie, the database may return tied rows in different orders across queries, so paginated results repeat or skip models.
Constraints: Do not append model_id a second time when the caller sorts by model_id; the has_model_id check prevents a duplicate ORDER BY clause. Any new ordering branch in this method must keep these tiebreakers at the end.
applies: Any change to sort handling in SqlAlchemyStore logged model search (search_logged_models and its order_by helper).
says: The same logged model appears on multiple pages when sorting by a column.
Some models are missing when paging through sorted experiment model results.
Make logged model list pagination stable when items share identical sort values.
Next page in the models view skips entries when sorting by timestamp.
search: Sorting logged models in SqlAlchemyStore._apply_order_by_search_logged_models must enforce a deterministic ORDER BY ending with creation_timestamp_ms desc and model_id asc tiebreakers. This total ordering ensures pagination tokens resolve to unique positions and prevents tied rows from repeating or skipping across pages. The has_model_id guard ensures model_id is not appended a second time if already requested by the caller. Any new ordering branch in _apply_order_by_search_logged_models must preserve these trailing tiebreakers.
